verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB documents that the s3() and url() table functions 'work as documented', which gives it its own way to read files in object storage directly. The evidence frames this only as ingestion, though, and never mentions Parquet, Iceberg, or Delta. missing for 10: explicit querying of files in place without loading, Iceberg support, Delta Lake support, explicit Parquet format support, independent or hands-on corroboration.
